instructions: For each generated question, compare to the case references/rubric. Set factual_accuracy to correct/incorrect/unverifiable, ambiguous to true/false, relevant and difficulty_ok to true/false. null means Not measured.

cases.rubric: Each question must be answerable from the cited tutorial page; exactly one choice correct; no Python-version-specific claim unless stated.
Subtle cases must be decidable from the cited page; reject questions relying on unstated interpreter behaviour.
Answers must agree with the cited model documentation of the stable Django release.
Answers must agree with the cited queries documentation; reject invented ORM methods.
Answers must agree with the cited react.dev reference pages; reject class-component-only or deprecated guidance.
Answers must agree with the cited handbook page; code snippets must be valid TypeScript.
